status: development inputs, not measured results or sealed acceptance cases
purpose: Compare equivalent rich and rough wording; judge preserved meaning and useful supported structure, not identical graph topology.

pairs.rough: 30 ppl design agency. always bespoke. competitors doing productised design subs fixed monthly unlimited requests. should we launch? £80/hr bespoke might get cannibalised but recurring rev less feast/famine. utilisation ~65%. lose roughly 1/3 prospects on price before they see quality. creative director worried subs lower brand positioning.
checks: Keep the qualitative purpose; no invented user-owned MRR target.
Retain agency size, hourly price, utilisation, lost prospects, cannibalisation, revenue stability and attributed brand concern.
Supportable capacity/profitability mechanisms and labelled hypotheses are useful; arbitrary assumed prices or guaranteed demand are not.

pairs.rough: lease ends 3 months MUST choose 2 offices. A city centre 2000 sq ft £55/sq ft 5min walk train no parking. B business park 3500 sq ft £28/sq ft free 40 car spaces 30min public transport. 45 staff 60% train 40% drive. collaboration top priority.
checks: Retain every office attribute, commute share and the lease deadline.
No supposedly feasible stay-put option or invented rental period.
Keep collaboration qualitative; access, travel burden and space are plausible mechanisms without invented effect sizes.

pairs.rough: SaaS 5000 customers Basic £19/mo 60% users Pro £49 30% Enterprise £149 10%. MRR now £215k need £250k in 6mo churn no more 5%. A all +15% to 22/56/171. B Enterprise only +30% to194 rest same. C Basic/Pro +10% to21/54 Enterprise -5% to142. what changes?
checks: Preserve all supplied percentages, prices, MRR and constraints, including inconsistent arithmetic and rounded prices.
Expose rather than silently repair the inconsistency.
Represent degree options using shared levers, without an extra option solely to meet a quota.

pairs.rough: series A healthtech 18mo runway board wants 3x users THIS YEAR plus burn -30%. self serve lower CAC lots engineering upfront OR enterprise higher margins longer sales more headcount. NHS data rule expected Q3 could open OR restrict patient data access affects both differently.
checks: Retain two aims, the burn constraint, opposing regulation outcomes and strategy trade-offs.
Do not turn 18-month runway into every aim's deadline or invent the regulation's exact date/chance.
Do not turn uncertainty about patient-data access into an already-resolved direction.

pairs.rough: meal kit subs 8000 active churn12% MONTHLY AOV£35 NPS42 waste8% ingredients shipped support400 tickets/WEEK sourcing£14/box. switch weekly to flexible choose delivery days? or keep weekly add premium organic only £49/box.
checks: Keep all observables, natural units, current rates and alternative scope.

Represent plausible scheduling/service/cost mechanisms while retaining uncertainty about causality.

pairs.rough: B2B marketplace 500 suppliers 2000 buyers. £400k AI matching: match quality up -> buyer satisfaction -> more buyers -> more suppliers -> match quality. OR £400k manual team 8 curators handpick supplier recs. annual GMV£15m take2.5% target£25m GMV 18mo supplier churn20% ANNUAL buyer acquisition£850.
checks: Keep both £400k investments, eight curators, baseline/target/window, take rate, annual churn and acquisition cost.
Keep the reinforcing causal belief visible without an invalid computational cycle, invented dynamics or double-counting.
If the schema cannot express a time-dependent relationship, explain the representation limit rather than silently erase it.
